title: 第21章 灵武双修第22章 大队长的职位
content_zh:
“灵武双修是什么？”
江平安摸着发麻的右臂，很是不解，第一次听到这个词。
“就是修炼灵气与修炼身体，两条路一起走。”李云天解释道。
江平安恍然大悟，“那确实是。”
之前得到呼吸吐纳法，后来修炼血气诀，确实是两条路一起走。
“多谢先生救我性命。”
他抬手抱拳，对着面前的老者微微鞠躬，之前听人说，江湖上就这么打招呼。
如果不是这位老先生，他肯定会被那两个士兵抓走，然后在非人地折磨中死亡。
李云天喝了口酒，笑着摆了摆手，“不用感谢我，感谢将军就行，是将军的命令。”
“将军的恩情归将军，先生的恩情归先生，两者不能混为一谈。”江平安认真道。
母亲告诉过他，做人要懂得感恩，谁对你好都要记住。
“哈哈。”
李云天很喜欢面前这个礼貌的小子，“咱们修士不称呼先生，你应该称呼我为前辈。”
“多谢前辈救命之恩。”江平安再次说道。
“感觉你什么都不懂，来，坐下，给你讲讲修士的知识。”
李云天非常随意地坐在了凳子上，没有一点架子，头发乱糟糟的，像是一个老农，很有亲和力。
他喝了口酒，又挠了挠头，“从哪讲起好呢？就从修炼开讲吧。”
“世上的修士有三大种，分为灵修、体修、魂修，其中灵修修士最多，也是主流修炼方向，灵修可以延伸出锻造师、符文师、丹药师……”
江平安笔直地坐在一旁，认真聆听，他对修行的事情了解得太少了。
一个瑰丽浩大的修仙世界如同画卷一般，在他面前展开，让他心神荡漾。

原来修行境界有这么多，原来他一生都走不完的灵台国只是一个小国，原来储物袋要烙印上神识才能正确使用……
江平安听得如痴如醉，很多传说故事让他神往，听了一天都不觉得疲倦。
“你身体还没完全恢复，就先讲这么多，以后慢慢给你说。”
李云天已经喝完七八瓶酒，脑袋晕乎乎的，想要睡觉。
“前辈，您知道该如何成仙吗？”江平安最后问道。
“成仙？”
原本醉醺醺的李云天忽然清醒许多，抬头看向窗外的天空，喃喃道：“仙道缥缈，我这种小人物哪知道如何成仙。”
“或许，只有学会大夏国开国国主留下的至高秘术，才有机会成仙吧。”
“至高秘书？”江平安心头一震，“那要怎么才能学会大夏国国主留下的秘术？”
他现在也知道学习的术法越厉害，战斗力就越厉害，修为境界就会越高。
“嗝～”
李云天打了个酒嗝，重新恢复了醉醺醺的状态。
“不要想了，那种秘术只有皇室，或者对大夏国有重大贡献才能学。”
“你要是能灭掉灵台国，或许就有机会，困了困了，老夫先回去睡了。”
李云天拿着酒葫芦，摇摇晃晃地往外走。
“前辈，我送你。”江平安赶紧起身。
content_en:
"What is the dual cultivation of spirit and martial arts?"
Jiang Ping'an touched his numb right arm and was very puzzled. It was the first time he heard this word.
"It means cultivating spiritual energy and cultivating the body, two paths go together." Li Yuntian explained.
Jiang Ping'an suddenly realized, "That's true."
I obtained the Breathing and Breathing Technique before, and later practiced the Blood Qi Technique. They were indeed two paths walking together.
"Thank you sir for saving my life."
He raised his hands and cupped his fists, and bowed slightly to the old man in front of him. He had heard someone say before that this was the way to say hello in the world.
If it weren't for this old gentleman, he would definitely have been captured by the two soldiers and died of inhuman torture.
Li Yuntian took a sip of wine, smiled and waved his hand, "No need to thank me, just thank the general. It's the general's order."
"The general's kindness belongs to the general, and the gentleman's kindness belongs to the gentleman. The two cannot be confused." Jiang Ping'an said seriously.
His mother once told him that as a person, you must know how to be grateful and remember whoever treats you well.
"Haha."
Li Yuntian liked the polite boy in front of him very much, "We monks don't call me sir, you should call me senior."
"Thank you, senior, for saving your life." Jiang Ping'an said again.
"I feel like you don't understand anything. Come on, sit down, and I'll tell you about monk knowledge."
Li Yuntian sat on the stool very casually, without any airs, with messy hair, like an old farmer, very approachable.
He took a sip of wine and scratched his head, "Where should I start? Let's start with cultivation."
"There are three major types of monks in the world, which are divided into spiritual cultivation, physical cultivation, and soul cultivation. Among them, spiritual cultivation monks are the most common and are the mainstream cultivation direction. Spiritual cultivation can extend to blacksmiths, rune masters, and alchemy masters..."
Jiang Ping'an sat upright and listened carefully. He knew too little about spiritual practice.
A magnificent and vast world of cultivating immortals unfolded in front of him like a scroll, making his mind wander.
It turns out that there are so many realms of cultivation, it turns out that Lingtai Kingdom, which he will never visit in his lifetime, is just a small country, and it turns out that the storage bag needs to be imprinted with spiritual consciousness in order to be used correctly...
Jiang Ping'an was fascinated by the stories. He was fascinated by many legends and stories, and he didn't feel tired even after listening to them all day.
"You haven't fully recovered yet, so I'll tell you this much first, and I'll tell you more slowly later."
Li Yuntian had already finished seven or eight bottles of wine, his head was dizzy and he wanted to sleep.
"Senior, do you know how to become an immortal?" Jiang Pingan finally asked.
"Become an immortal?"
Li Yuntian, who was originally drunk, suddenly became sober. He raised his head to look at the sky outside the window and murmured: "The path of immortality is so elusive. How can a little person like me know how to become an immortal?"
"Perhaps, only by learning the supreme secret technique left by the founder of Great Xia can we have a chance to become an immortal."
"Supreme Secretary?" Jiang Ping'an was shocked, "Then how can we learn the secret skills left by the king of Daxia?"
He now also knows that the more powerful the techniques he learns, the more powerful his combat effectiveness will be, and the higher his cultivation level will be.
"Hiccup~"
Li Yuntian burped and returned to his drunken state.
"Don't think about it. Only the royal family or those who have made significant contributions to Daxia can learn that kind of secret skill."
"If you can destroy the Lingtai Kingdom, you might have a chance. I'm tired. I'll go back to sleep first."
Li Yuntian took the wine gourd and staggered out.
"Senior, I'll see you off." Jiang Ping'an quickly stood up.
